title: 第一卷 第11章 天子震怒
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

程壑川站起身，行了一礼：“殿下，臣有个不情之请。”

“说。”

“这个案子，如果查到最后，陈宁确实有罪，臣无话可说。但如果他是被冤枉的——”

“如果他是被冤枉的，”朱标接过话，“我会在父皇面前替他说话。你放心，我不是那种见死不救的人。”

程壑川深深鞠了一躬。

走出东宫的时候，天已经快黑了。

夕阳把整座皇宫染成了金黄色，远处的琉璃瓦在阳光下闪闪发光。

程壑川站在宫门口，深吸一口气。

他忽然想到一个问题。

朱元璋知道他去东宫了吗？

答案是肯定的。

锦衣卫无时无刻不在监视他，他去东宫这么大的事，一定早就传到了朱元璋耳朵里。

那朱元璋会怎么想？

一个七品小官，刚被他从诏狱里放出来，转眼就跑到太子那里去“献书”。

在别人看来，这是结党营私，这是攀附储君，这是找死。

但程壑川赌的是朱元璋的另一面。

朱元璋虽然多疑，但他不蠢。

他知道程壑川去东宫不是为了攀附，是为了救人。

而救人这件事，恰好符合朱元璋内心深处那个“不想滥杀无辜”的念头。

他只是赌得很大。

赌输了，死。赌赢了，活。

就这么简单。

又过了五天。

程壑川正在修史馆里跟宋濂争论元顺帝的庙号问题，福伯忽然气喘吁吁地跑了进来。

“少爷！少爷！”福伯脸色煞白，“宫里来人了！说是陛下召您即刻入宫！”

程壑川手里的笔掉在了地上。

宋濂抬起头，看了他一眼，目光里闪过一丝担忧，但什么都没说。

程壑川深吸一口气，整了整官袍，跟着福伯出了修史馆。

门口站着一个太监，面白无须，穿着蓝色袍子，手里拿着一柄拂尘。

“程大人，”太监笑眯眯地说，“跟咱家走吧。”

程壑川认得这个人，乾清宫的大太监王安，朱元璋身边最得力的人之一。

王安亲自来“请”，说明事情不小。

Cheng Hechuan stood up and saluted: "Your Highness, I have a heartfelt request."

"Say."

"If this case is investigated to the end and Chen Ning is indeed guilty, I have nothing to say. But if he is wrongly accused -"

"If he is wronged," Zhu Biao took over, "I will speak for him in front of my father. Don't worry, I'm not the kind of person who refuses to save someone."

Cheng Hechuan bowed deeply.

When we walked out of the East Palace, it was almost dark.

The setting sun dyed the entire palace golden yellow, and the glazed tiles in the distance sparkled in the sun.

Cheng Hechuan stood at the entrance of the palace and took a deep breath.

A question suddenly occurred to him.

Did Zhu Yuanzhang know that he went to the East Palace?

The answer is yes.

The Jin Yiwei were monitoring him all the time. Such a big thing as his going to the East Palace must have reached Zhu Yuanzhang's ears long ago.

What would Zhu Yuanzhang think?

A seventh-grade petty official, who had just been released from prison, ran to the prince to "present a book" in the blink of an eye.

In the eyes of others, this is forming a clique for personal gain, clinging to the prince, and seeking death.

But Cheng Hechuan was betting on another side of Zhu Yuanzhang.

Although Zhu Yuanzhang was suspicious, he was not stupid.

He knew that Cheng Hechuan went to the East Palace not to cling, but to save people.

The matter of rescuing people happened to be in line with Zhu Yuanzhang's innermost thoughts of "not wanting to kill innocent people indiscriminately".

He just gambled big.

If you lose the bet, you die.The bet is won, live.

It's that simple.

Another five days passed.

Cheng Hechuan was arguing with Song Lian in the history museum about the temple name of Emperor Yuan Shun, when Uncle Fu suddenly ran in out of breath.

"Master! Master!" Uncle Fu's face turned pale. "Someone is coming from the palace! His Majesty has summoned you to enter the palace immediately!"

The pen in Cheng Hechuan's hand fell to the ground.

Song Lian raised his head and glanced at him, a trace of worry flashed in his eyes, but he said nothing.

Cheng Hechuan took a deep breath, adjusted his official robe, and followed Uncle Fu out of the History Museum.

Standing at the door was a eunuch with a white face and no beard, wearing a blue robe and holding a whisk in his hand.

"Master Cheng," the eunuch said with a smile, "come with us."

Cheng Hechuan recognized this person. Wang An, the eunuch of Qianqing Palace, was one of the most capable people around Zhu Yuanzhang.

Wang An came to "invite" him personally, which shows that the matter is not trivial.
